upstream.name: CrossEarth
upstream.note: Not redistributed. Upstream license headers are retained in the upstream clone; this repository ships only the runtime/driver overlay around it.

deviations_from_published: iterations 30000 -> 10000 (~89 epochs at 450 images, our 100-epoch protocol; 30000 projects to 5.3 h and exceeds the 3:59:59 partition ceiling)
bf16 autocast with mmcv deformable attention forced to fp32 (mmcv 2.1.0 has no bf16 ms_deform_attn_forward_cuda kernel)
validation is source-city only; the released DG configs put the target domain in the validation dataloader
test_cfg slide -> whole (image size equals crop size)
deviation_source: copied verbatim from armf_crossearth_train.py run_cfg['deviations_from_published'], which is what each run's run.json records
